localizar.es: Sin cambios bruscos de temperatura: la condensación en la cáscara facilita la entrada de Salmonella (Reg. (CE) 589/2008, art. 2).
localizar.en: Shell eggs must be held at 45 °F (7 °C) or below (21 CFR 115.50 and 118.4(e); FDA Food Code 2022 §3-202.11(C)). Store them below ready-to-eat food.

localizar.es: Productos de limpieza, desinfectantes y sus fichas de datos de seguridad
localizar.en: Cleaning chemicals, sanitizers and their Safety Data Sheets

localizar.es: Separado y señalizado; NUNCA sobre ni junto a alimentos ni sobre superficies de trabajo (Reg. (CE) 852/2004, Anexo II, Cap. IX).
localizar.en: Separate and labeled; NEVER above or next to food or on work surfaces (FDA Food Code 2022 §7-201.11).

textos_cifra_derivada.en: 5. The order totals are in rows 40 to 42: net amount (pre-tax), tax amount and order total. Right below, in row 43, the file tells you whether the order MEETS THE VENDOR'S MINIMUM and, if not, how much you are short: that is what saves you the delivery fee. Rows 45 to 48 break the order down by tax rate (0%, 5% and 20% by default: type the rates you actually pay).
textos_cifra_derivada.calc: Filas iguales al ES: H40:H42 totales, A43/H43 mínimo, A45:D48 desglose; A46:A48 = 0 / 5 / 20 editables (D11). Ejemplo EN: 12 × 17.21 + 12 × 10.31 + 10 × 1.6 = 346.24 ≥ mínimo 300 → «meets».

textos_cifra_derivada.en: 3. Choose the product's category (the same 10 used across the kit) and the "Suggested Family" column proposes the food safety family on its own. REFINE it in the "Family" column when the line calls for it: most raw meat, poultry, fish and dairy share the 41 °F (5 °C) limit, but live shellfish and shell eggs may arrive at up to 45 °F (7 °C), hot food must arrive at 135 °F (57 °C) or above, and frozen food must arrive frozen. Shell eggs are bought under "Dairy & Eggs", so switch them to "Shell eggs".
textos_cifra_derivada.calc: mapas.FAMILIAS: máx. 41 °F en las filas 4-7, 9, 11 y 13; 45 °F en 8 (shellstock) y 15 (shell eggs); mín. 135 °F en 12 (hot TCS); congelado ≤ 0 °F en 10. FAMILIA_POR_CATEGORIA: Dairy & Eggs → Dairy & other refrigerated TCS (41 °F), de ahí el aviso de los huevos.

textos_cifra_derivada.en: 4. Type the measured temperature: the cell turns RED and the temperature check column says REJECT as soon as it falls outside its family's range. There are five possible answers and it pays to know them: ACCEPT · REJECT (too warm) · REJECT (too cold), because fish at -4 °F (-20 °C) arrived frozen and lettuce at 28 °F (-2 °C) is frost-damaged · N/A when that family is not temperature-controlled (dry goods, beverages, non-food) · and NO LIMIT FOR THIS FAMILY when what you typed in "Family" is not in the table. That last one is not a bug: it is the file refusing to give you an approval it cannot back up.
textos_cifra_derivada.calc: -4 °F < 30 °F (mín. de Fresh fish & shucked shellfish) → too cold; 28 °F < 32 °F (mín. de Whole produce) → too cold; N/A = filas 16-18 de mapas.FAMILIAS. Los huevos salen de la lista N/A del ES: en EE. UU. se controlan a 45 °F. Estados = mapas.LITERALES.

textos_cifra_derivada.en: This is where the log's "Suggested Family" column comes from. REFINE it in the "Family" column when the line calls for it: live shellfish and shell eggs may arrive at up to 45 °F, hot food must arrive at 135 °F or above, and frozen food must arrive frozen. Shell eggs are bought under "Dairy & Eggs", whose default family is dairy (41 °F): switch them to "Shell eggs".
textos_cifra_derivada.calc: Mismos límites que 04!Instructions!A7 (mapas.FAMILIAS filas 8, 10, 12, 15; FAMILIA_POR_CATEGORIA[Dairy & Eggs]).

textos_cifra_derivada.en: 4. In "Waste Dashboard", type the month's purchases in the green cell, net of any tax you can reclaim (in the U.S., usually the invoice subtotal). Without it the 3% target cannot be calculated; the target percentage is editable too.
textos_cifra_derivada.calc: 3 % = Waste Dashboard!B11 = 0.03 (D24, sin cambio). Compras de ejemplo B10 = 14,900.00.

textos_cifra_derivada.en: TARGET: keep waste below 3% of the month's purchases. It is a percentage of YOUR purchases, not a fixed dollar amount: $500 of waste is a lot for a bar and very little for a hotel.
textos_cifra_derivada.calc: Objetivo con los datos de ejemplo: 0.03 × 14,900.00 = 447.00; mermas de ejemplo = 110.13 (0.74 %). Los 500 son ilustrativos (mismo papel que en el ES; D13 admite $ en texto de ejemplo US).

textos_cifra_derivada.en: Type the month's purchases in the green cell, net of recoverable tax (the subtotal of your vendor invoices). Without it, the kit's own 3% target cannot be calculated: that is why the dollar target is no longer a fixed "under $500" but that percentage of YOUR purchases.

Tax you can reclaim is not part of food cost. If you copy the invoice total instead of the net amount, your food cost comes out inflated by the tax on the invoice (up to 20% with UK VAT) and every decision you base on it will be wrong. In the U.S., food bought for resale is usually tax exempt, so subtotal and total often match; sales tax you cannot reclaim is a real cost and stays in.
textos_cifra_derivada.calc: «entre un 4 % y un 21 %» (tipos de IVA ES) → el tipo de la factura; 20 % = VAT estándar UK, la tasa más alta del desglose por defecto 0 / 5 / 20 (D11).

textos_cifra_derivada.en: Sample figures consistent with January in "Spend by Category": $14,900 of purchases, $6,100 of beginning and $5,900 of ending inventory, $48,700 of sales and 1,450 covers give a food cost of 31.0%, within target. Replace them with yours.
- There are free rows down to row 84.
textos_cifra_derivada.calc: Estructura duplicada sin cambios: Quick Count datos 5-84 (50 de ejemplo en 5-54 + 30 libres), total en la fila 86.

textos_cifra_derivada.en: The milk example, with the file's own numbers: 2 gal a day, a 12-day shelf life and a maximum stock of 16 gal. The EOQ comes out at 64 gal. The shelf-life cap brings it down to 17 gal, which is 70% of those 12 days (8.4 days of use, not 12: the other 30% is the margin for a slow day). And the maximum stock finally sets it at 16 gal.

The parameters come with an order cost of 3 (in your currency), a 25% annual holding cost and a 70% shelf-life factor. Replace them with yours in "Parameters": they are three green cells and they affect all 30 lines.
textos_cifra_derivada.calc: Parameters!D4 = 3, D5 = 0.25, D12 = 0.7 (D24, heredados del ES); Reorder Calculator filas 4-33.
